title: The reftable test uses a real reftable store
why: Lane notes-fix-page ([ended:lane:-notes-fix-page]), from #2419 round 1 record 6737973073 (tests for #2308, push-new-branch), 04:41 CST Nov 9: fixture REF_REFTABLE (hooks/test_guard.py) is an empty folder in a files-backend repo, not git's reftable store, so it pins routing only.
